map.症状自查能替代医生诊断吗？: Can Symptom Self-Check Replace a Doctor's Diagnosis?
map.不能。它是基于常见规律的初步分流参考，帮助判断「大概去哪个科、是否要尽快就医」，: No. It is a first-pass triage reference based on common patterns, meant to help you judge roughly which department to visit and whether to seek care promptly; it cannot replace consultation, examination, and tests. Seek care promptly if symptoms worsen or persist.
